description: This file defines a utility function 'runHealthcheck' which performs a network connectivity health check against a backend server, using fetch to send a GET request to a specified health check endpoint. It handles JSON and non-JSON responses and reports success or failure along with relevant details.

methods.name: runHealthcheck(signal)
methods.description: An async function that performs a health check HTTP GET request to the backend, handling response parsing and error conditions, returning a structured result indicating success status, response code, messages, and data.
